description: Configuration schema for the GenAI CLI tool.

default_model.description: The default model to use for generating responses.

system_prompt.description: The system prompt that sets the context for the AI assistant.

history_len.description: The number of previous interactions to keep in the conversation history.

start_with_last_session.description: Whether to start a new session with the last session's history.

your_name.description: The name to refer to the user in the conversation.
